text:
anya: heads up — saw a spike in reconnects + duplicate streaming bill events after yesterday's proxy probe rollout :frowning:
sam: which rollout? any traces?
anya: eu-central proxy pool. we lowered keepalive interval (5s -> 1s) and shortened idle_close to 25s; that's when the bump started. console shows tenants with 2x streaming units for short windows
devon: logs look like probe -> immediate RST -> client retries with same resume token -> runtime sometimes creates new billable session
anya: trace snippet:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-24T22:12:01Z host=px-eu probe=keepalive timeout action=RST_SENT conn=0x7f
[client] 2026-03-24T22:12:02Z sdk=v1.4 reconnect resume=rt-abc fp=sha1:123
[runtime] 2026-03-24T22:12:02Z resume=rt-abc result=stale create_session id=sess-999 billable=true
```
harry: SDK behavior differs — some treat RST as terminal and clear state, others attempt resume. combined with our aggressive socket churn this allows overlapping sessions for same resume token
sonya: ops: short term we can mute streaming-heartbeat alerts for the affected tenant set (dedupe window 30s). longer term need runtime semantics change to avoid double-billing on reattach
sam: what's the runtime option?
devon: idea: treat resume as idempotent within a short grace window when client fingerprint matches. pseudo:
```python
if token_exists(tok) and recent(token.last_seen, <=2s) and fp==token.fp:
    attach_existing_session(tok)  # non-billable
else:
    create_new_session()  # billable
```
sonya: will we need extra audit logs for billing reconciliation? yes — add resume.reattach audit event with tenant, token, fp, old_session, new_session
anya: proxy option too: feature-flag "suppress-hard-reset-if-resume" to send graceful close (FIN/close_notify) when resume header present. ops prefers runtime fix first to minimize low-level socket changes
harry: runtime change must be O(1) token lookup and gated behind an FF so we can roll back quickly. also add e2e sim for probe->rst->resume case
sam: customers already pinging CS. sonya can you coordinate customer comms about a short maintenance window and that we're investigating?
sonya: on it. I'll also prepare proxy FF rollback plan (revert keepalive to 5s) in case runtime canary doesn't stabilize metrics
deploy-bot: deploy requested: canary/runtime/reattach-grace-window -> queued on eng-runtime-canary
anya: plan: 1) runtime canary with reattach logic behind FF (target 10%) 2) console dedupe alert for 30s for impacted tenants 3) proxy FF to suppress RST as backup 4) billing retro-dedupe job if any overcharges detected
devon: I'll add metrics: resume.reattach count, resume.reattach_latency, and tag resume_source=probe-rst for postmortem filters
harry: timeline: land runtime canary in ~45m, monitor billing.delta, active_sockets_per_resume, resume.reattach. if safe, widen rollout to 50% then full
sonya: adding console banner: "Transient streaming billing spikes expected during canary rollout; contact eng-platform with trace ids". I'll also mute noisy alerts for the tenant cohort during the window
anya: thanks all — once canary is up I'll post graphs. adding test to streaming-e2e to reproduce probe->rst->resume now. :thumbsup:
